name: @marmo/astro
description: A astro tool to separate class name logic, create variants and manage styles.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && astro check --root test/fixtures/static && node test/types/check-negative.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/src/*.test.ts && npm run test:integration
scripts.package: npm run build && npm publish --access public
